tabs.content:
// Calls by the backend that answered, per minute. Calls with no backend (refused or failed) are left out.
GatewayCalls()
| where isnotempty(answered_by)
| summarize calls = count() by minute = bin(event_time, 1m), answered_by
| order by minute asc
tabs.title: answered_by_per_minute

tabs.content:
// End-to-end delay to first availability: the earliest ingestion time of the request minus event time, in seconds.
GatewayCalls()
| extend delay_s = (first_ingested - event_time) / 1s
| summarize p50 = percentile(delay_s, 50), p95 = percentile(delay_s, 95), max_s = max(delay_s), n = count()
tabs.title: delay_p50_p95_max

tabs.content:
// Minutes in which at least one call was answered by the secondary backend.
GatewayCalls()
| where answered_by == "secondary"
| summarize secondary_calls = count() by minute = bin(event_time, 1m)
| order by minute asc
tabs.title: failover_minutes

tabs.content:
// Calls the gateway itself refused (throttling), by status, per minute. Refused calls have no answered_by.
GatewayCalls()
| where refused_by_gateway == true
| summarize refusals = count() by minute = bin(event_time, 1m), status
| order by minute asc
tabs.title: refusals_per_minute

tabs.content:
// Requests by session and caller. GatewayCalls() is one row per request_id, so count() is exact.
GatewayCalls()
| summarize calls = count() by session, caller
| order by session asc, caller asc
tabs.title: session_counts

tabs.content:
let threshold = 5000;
// Caller-minutes whose summed tokens exceed the threshold (the Activator rule's condition).
GatewayCalls()
| where isnotnull(tokens)
| summarize tokens = sum(tokens) by minute = bin(event_time, 1m), caller
| where tokens > threshold
| order by minute asc, caller asc
tabs.title: token_spike_minutes

tabs.content:
// Tokens consumed per caller per minute. Calls with no token count are left out.
GatewayCalls()
| where isnotnull(tokens)
| summarize tokens = sum(tokens) by minute = bin(event_time, 1m), caller
| order by minute asc, caller asc
tabs.title: tokens_per_minute_per_caller
